abi: function registerMedia(bytes32 hash, string sourceName, string editHistory) external
function registerVersion(bytes32 parentHash, bytes32 newHash, string sourceName, string versionNote) external
function verifyMedia(bytes32 hash) external view returns (bool exists, address publisher, string sourceName, uint256 timestamp, string editHistory, bytes32 parentHash)
event MediaRegistered(bytes32 indexed hash, address indexed publisher, string sourceName, uint256 timestamp)
event MediaVersionRegistered(bytes32 indexed hash, bytes32 indexed parentHash, address indexed publisher, uint256 timestamp)
error AlreadyRegistered(bytes32 hash)
error ParentNotFound(bytes32 parentHash)
error NotParentPublisher(bytes32 parentHash, address caller)
function arbiter() view returns (address)
function raiseDispute(bytes32 hash, bytes32 evidenceHash, string evidenceNote) external
function resolveDispute(bytes32 hash, bool upheld, string ruling) external
function getDispute(bytes32 hash) view returns (uint8 status, address challenger, bytes32 evidenceHash, string evidenceNote, uint256 raisedAt, string ruling, uint256 resolvedAt)
event DisputeRaised(bytes32 indexed hash, address indexed challenger, bytes32 evidenceHash, uint256 timestamp)
event DisputeResolved(bytes32 indexed hash, address indexed arbiter, bool upheld, uint256 timestamp)
error MediaNotFound(bytes32 hash)
error CannotDisputeOwnWork(bytes32 hash)
error DisputeAlreadyOpen(bytes32 hash)
error DisputeAlreadyUpheld(bytes32 hash)
error NotArbiter(address caller)
error NoOpenDispute(bytes32 hash)
